app.name: Dasi
app.tagline: Mother-tongue subtitles for multilingual Korean classes
home.intro: The teacher speaks Korean; every student reads subtitles in their own language. After class, AI drafts the transcript, vocabulary and exercises for the teacher to review.
home.signInHint: Teachers and students sign in with a Google account.
login.title: Sign in to get started
login.consent: By signing in you agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy. Dasi records only when the teacher starts a lesson and everyone in the class has been told.
login.error: Sign-in failed. Try again, or use another Google account.
login.notConfigured: The app is not connected to Supabase. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to .env.local and restart.
login.demoHint: Test build: every try creates a new user. To try teacher and student together, open a second private window.
login.demoError: Could not start a trial session. In Supabase → Authentication → Sign In / Providers, turn on “Allow anonymous sign-ins” and try again.
onboarding.title: How will you use Dasi?
onboarding.teacherDesc: Create classes, teach with multilingual subtitles, assign homework
onboarding.studentDesc: Join with a class code, pick your mother tongue, review after class
onboarding.motherTongueHint: Subtitles, word meanings and explanations appear in this language. You can change it any time.
onboarding.errorLanguage: Choose your mother tongue to continue.
onboarding.errorSave: Could not save your choice. Try again.
classes.title: My classes
classes.empty: You have no classes yet. Create your first class, then send the invite code to your students.
newClass.title: Create a class
newClass.name: Class name
newClass.errorSave: Could not create the class. Try again.
classDetail.inviteHint: Students scan the QR code, or open Join a class and enter the code, then pick their mother tongue.
classDetail.noStudents: No students yet. Share the invite code {code} with your class.
classDetail.noLessons: No lessons yet. Lessons appear here once you start teaching this class.
classDetail.lessonsError: Could not load the lessons. Reload the page to try again.
newLesson.title: New lesson
newLesson.topic: Main content (helps the AI recognise grammar)
newLesson.formatRoomHint: One microphone for the teacher. Subtitles on the classroom TV.
newLesson.formatOnlineHint: Zoom, Meet or Google Classroom. Audio comes from the tab.
newLesson.formatHybridHint: The teacher uses a microphone; students read subtitles and ask questions on their phones.
newLesson.tabHint: In the next step, pick the Zoom or Meet tab and tick “Share tab audio”.
newLesson.tabPickHint: Click Pick a tab, choose the Zoom or Meet tab and tick “Share tab audio”.
newLesson.subtitlesHint: Taken from the mother tongues students chose in this class.
newLesson.subtitlesNone: This class has no students yet. The lesson still records Korean subtitles.
newLesson.subtitlesCapped: {n} students whose mother tongue is not listed above will read English.
newLesson.displayBilingualHint: Each student sees Korean and a translation in their mother tongue.
newLesson.displayKoreanHint: Only Korean is shown; tap a word to look it up.
newLesson.displayHiddenHint: Students tap a sentence to see its translation. Good for listening practice.
newLesson.checkWaiting: Waiting for the browser to allow access…
newLesson.errorMicDenied: The browser has not allowed the microphone. Click the lock icon in the address bar, allow Microphone, then click Try again.
newLesson.errorMicMissing: No microphone found. Plug one in or pick another microphone in step 2.
newLesson.errorMicBusy: Another app is using the microphone. Close it, then click Try again.
newLesson.errorMicOther: Could not open the microphone. Click Try again.
newLesson.errorTabCancelled: No tab was picked. Click Pick a tab and choose the Zoom or Meet tab.
newLesson.errorTabNoAudio: This tab is not sharing audio. Pick it again and tick “Share tab audio”.
newLesson.errorTabUnsupported: This browser cannot share tab audio. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.
newLesson.errorTabOther: Could not share the tab. Click Pick a tab to try again.
newLesson.consent: By clicking Start you confirm students have been told about and agreed to recording this lesson.
newLesson.waitingSources: Get every audio source ready to start
newLesson.noClasses: You have no classes yet. Create a class first, then start a lesson.
newLesson.errorInput: The lesson details are not valid. Check the title and try again.
newLesson.errorAlreadyLive: This class already has a lesson in progress. End it before starting a new one.
newLesson.errorSave: Could not create the lesson. Try again.
studentHome.title: Home
studentHome.empty: You have not joined a class yet. Enter the 6-character code from your teacher.
settings.title: Settings
settings.motherTongueHint: Subtitles, word meanings and explanations appear in this language in all your classes.
student.languageMissing: You have not chosen your mother tongue yet.
join.title: Join a class
join.codeHint: The 6 characters from your teacher, e.g. HANGUL
join.consent: I agree that lessons are recorded and processed by AI to create subtitles and study material.
join.errorCode: A class code has 6 letters and digits (no 0, O, 1 or I).
join.errorNotFound: No class has this code. Check the code with your teacher.
join.errorConsent: You need to agree to recording to join.
join.errorLanguage: You have not chosen your mother tongue yet. Choose it in Settings, then join.
join.errorRole: Only student accounts can join a class with a code.
join.errorSave: Could not join the class. Try again.
state.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
lessonDetail.stillLive: This lesson is still in progress.
lessonDetail.published: Sent to the class. Students now see the transcript, vocabulary and summary in their mother tongue.
lessonDetail.noQuestions: No questions yet. Questions students send with “Hold to ask” will appear here.
lessonDetail.processingHint: You can close this page. It updates by itself when done.
lessonDetail.processingFailed: The summary and vocabulary could not be written yet. Dasi retries a few times; if it still fails after 10 minutes, tell your administrator.
lessonDetail.loadError: Could not load this content. Reload the page to try again.
lessonDetail.noSegments: No sentences were recognised in this lesson.
lessonDetail.noVocab: This lesson has no vocabulary yet.
lessonDetail.vocabHint: {n} items picked by AI from the lesson. Edit or delete them before sending to the class.
lessonDetail.noSummary: This lesson has no summary yet.
lessonDetail.summaryHint: Each student receives the summary in their mother tongue.
lessonDetail.publish: Approve and send to the class
lessonDetail.publishHint: Once sent, students see this lesson. You can still edit it afterwards.
lessonDetail.errorPublish: Could not send. Reload the page: the lesson may already have been sent.
lessonDetail.errorVocab: The word cannot be empty and the TOPIK level is 1–6.
lessonDetail.errorDuplicate: This lesson already has that word. Edit the other item or delete the duplicate.
lessonDetail.errorSummary: The summary cannot be empty (at most 4000 characters).
live.backAria: End or leave the live class screen
live.empty: Start speaking. Korean sentences and their translations appear here.
live.pausedNote: Recording is paused. Students see “Teacher paused”. Press Resume or the space bar to continue.
live.noQuestions: No questions yet. Questions students send with “Hold to ask” appear here in Korean.
live.tabIdle: No tab shared. Click Pick a tab, choose the Zoom or Meet tab and tick “Share tab audio”.
live.endBody: The {time} recording will be saved. AI then writes a summary and vocabulary for you to review before sending them to the class.
live.error.bad_message: The app sent invalid data. Reload the page.
live.error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again and reopen the lesson.
live.error.forbidden: You are not this class's teacher.
live.error.not_configured: The subtitle server is not set up. Tell your administrator.
live.error.stt_failed: Speech recognition is not working right now. Subtitles may be missing; try restarting the audio source.
live.error.save_failed: A sentence could not be saved. The lesson continues.
live.error.end_failed: The lesson could not be ended. Press End to try again.
live.error.sourceClosed: The audio connection to the server closed. Press Try again.
studentLive.fallbackEnglish: This class does not use {language} yet. Showing English instead.
studentLive.koreanOnly: This class does not use {language} yet. Subtitles are in Korean only.
studentLive.waiting: Waiting for the teacher to speak. Subtitles appear here.
studentLive.tapHint: Tap an underlined word to see its meaning.
studentLive.endedBody: Your teacher will send the transcript, vocabulary and summary after reviewing them.
studentLive.notMember: You have not joined this class. Join it with the code your teacher sent.
studentLive.noMeaning: No meaning in your language yet.
